notes.title: DEMO Hotfix for Widescreen Displays
notes.notes:
The Arcade FC DEMO now (better) supports widescreen displays.


Windowed mode
You may toggle windowed and full-screen mode with F11 for even more flexibility.


Camera Zoom
Adjust the camera zoom with PAGE-UP/DOWN (HOME to reset) to zoom in or out and adjust the game to your screen resolution and preferences.



Thanks to all the players who pointed this out!
